answer_1.quote: We propose a novel summarization task that emphasizes supporting decision making ...

answer_2.quote: We design evaluation metrics based on our three desiderata ... We use SUM‑QE, ... we measure the mean squared error ... we measure the Wasserstein distance ...

answer_4.quote: We use Mechanical Turk to conduct our human evaluation ... participants are shown pairs of restaurants and asked to guess which will be rated better after 50 reviews based on the summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers are presented with summary pairs and must decide which restaurant will have a higher future rating; they also rate usefulness and confidence of the summaries.
